gloss: ideation technique; method of generating ideas

definitions.gloss: ideation technique; method of generating ideas
definitions.explanation: A structured method for producing new ideas or ways of thinking, such as brainstorming or mind mapping. Compound of {発想|はっそう} (conception, idea) + {法|ほう} (method).

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{発想法|はっそうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I'm learning a new ideation technique.

examples.japanese: マインドマップ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{発想法|はっそうほう}だ。
examples.english: Mind mapping is a popular ideation technique.

examples.japanese: ⟦{行|い}き{詰|づ}まった→行き詰まる：09346_ikizumaru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{視点|してん}→視点：03187_shiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧{発想法|はっそうほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: When you hit a wall, an ideation technique that shifts your perspective is useful.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{発想|はっそう}→発想：04309_hassou⟧ (conception, idea) + ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (method). Refers to a named or systematic approach to producing ideas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発想法|はっそうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to learn an ideation technique
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{発想法|はっそうほう}: a new ideation technique
- {発想法|はっそうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れる→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧: to adopt an ideation technique

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発想|はっそう}→発想：04309_hassou⟧: idea; conception — the idea itself, not the method for generating it
- ⟦{手法|しゅほう}→手法：12762_shuhou⟧: technique; approach — broader, any method, not specific to producing ideas
